summary: Diagnostic-only browser regression (iter82) executed on preview origin using synthetic same-origin harness. Captured real OSM tile request headers for sandbox/srcDoc/url-doc variants without opening authenticated app or calling business APIs.

integration_issues.flow: Map tile load from sandboxed iframe (srcDoc and URL document)
integration_issues.issue: Tile requests from A/B/C had empty Referer and empty Origin headers; only unsandboxed baseline sent Referer=https://voom-ios.preview.emergentagent.com/. If provider policy requires Referer, sandboxed map can hit 403.

action_items: Do NOT change production based on assumptions alone; use this header evidence to choose fix path.
If stable Referer is required, evaluate moving web map rendering to normal DOM Leaflet context (non-sandboxed iframe) with trusted dependency controls.
Re-test on Chromium and WebKit after main-agent implementation; this run executed Chromium only (WebKit not available in current browser automation path).
critical_code_review_comments: Current sandbox=allow-scripts context suppresses Referer in observed tile requests for both srcDoc and same-origin URL document variants.
Adding meta referrer + iframe referrerPolicy did not alter headers in sandboxed cases.
Probe remained fail-closed: blocked_business_calls=0; no auth/edge/crm/business traffic was executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Observed 4 tile requests total (A/B/C sandboxed + D unsandboxed baseline). Status/content-type were 200 image/png for all. A/B/C request headers had referer='' and origin=''; D had referer='https://voom-ios.preview.emergentagent.com/'. Screenshots confirm world tile visual loaded in all cases.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction in synthetic preview-origin harness: (1) sandbox allow-scripts + srcDoc, (2) sandbox allow-scripts + srcDoc + strict-origin-when-cross-origin, (3) sandbox allow-scripts + same-origin URL doc, (4) unsandboxed URL baseline. Result: only unsandboxed baseline emitted Referer. Root cause candidate: sandboxed iframe request context yields opaque/no-referrer behavior for cross-origin tile image requests. Mitigation direction: avoid sandboxed iframe map surface for production tile fetching if provider enforces referrer policy.
